Type: tufted upholstered storage bench
Use: seating and storage at the foot of a bed or in an entryway; bedroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: linen-look fabric upholstery, button-tufted lift-up lid, dark turned wood legs
Colors: warm natural beige, black
Shape: long rectangular box, padded tufted top, hinged lid, four short turned bun legs, long and low, substantial
Feel: soft, elegant, calm
Goes with: white bedding, dark wood, neutral walls; traditional or transitional bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Nori Tufted Storage Bench, 58"L, Natural
product.description: With a roomy interior and slow-close hinges, this upholstered storage bench is as functional as it is stylish. Lovely tufted fabric on the top offers a traditional look, giving your blankets and off-season clothes a stylish new home. 58"L x 18"W x 18"H 100 polyester fabric on a hardwood frame Traditional style with neutral color fabric, blending with transitional and modern décor A stylish piece for storing blankets or clothes; slow-close hinges for safe closure No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
